acip: MA GRUB NA, DNGOS PO CHOS CAN, KHYOD MI RTAG PA DANG THA DAD KYI BYE BRAG YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD MI RTAG PA DANG THA DAD YIN, KHYOD MI RTAG PA DANG THA DAD DANG BDAG GCIG TU 'BREL, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING MI RTAG PA DANG THA DAD YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA GRUB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, dngos po chos can, khyod mi rtag pa dang tha dad kyi bye brag yin par thal, khyod mi rtag pa dang tha dad yin, khyod mi rtag pa dang tha dad dang bdag gcig tu 'brel, khyod ma yin zhing mi rtag pa dang tha dad yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub pa'i phyir
english: I disagree that working things are characteristic of being different from changing things as a quality. If you do disagree, then let's consider working things. They are too characteristic of being different from changing things as a quality, Because (1) they are separate from changing things; (2) they are related to being different from changing things in such a way that to be a working thing is to be different from changing things; and (3) there are many examples of things which are not working things but which are still different from changing things.
